{{Quote|My father was an admiral and my mother was a Senator, but they were both killed during the war.|Spirakris Zarem|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''father''' of [[Spirakris Zarem]] was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He [[Marriage/Legends|married]] a [[Spirakris Zarem's mother|senator]] and had a daughter named Spirakris, but both he and his wife were [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the war.
